title: Learning from Mutants: Teaching Small Language Models to Synthesise Loop Invariants
abstract: arXiv:2611.19569v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have proven promising for synthesising loop invariants, a long-standing obstacle to automated program verification. Yet, frontier LLMs are typically accessible only through third-party APIs, hampering reproducibility and local deployment. Small language models (SLMs) sidestep these obstacles but require task-specific fine-tuning, for which high-quality training data is needed. We present a failure-driven data curation method for fine-tuning language models to synthesise loop invariants. Inspired by mutation testing, our approach applies semantic mutation operators to ground-truth invariants, producing semantic mutants that induce verification failure. Each mutant is paired with verifier feedback and its ground-truth counterpart, yielding training examples for feedback-guided invariant refinement. translated_title: 从变异体中学习：教会小语言模型合成循环不变式
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）已被证明在合成循环不变式方面具有前景，而循环不变式一直是自动化程序验证的长期障碍。然而，前沿大语言模型通常只能通过第三方API访问，这阻碍了可复现性和本地部署。小语言模型（SLMs）可以避开这些障碍，但需要针对特定任务的微调，而这又需要高质量的训练数据。我们提出了一种失败驱动的数据筛选方法，用于微调语言模型以合成循环不变式。受变异测试的启发，我们的方法将语义变异算子应用于基准真值不变式，产生会导致验证失败的语义变异体。每个变异体都与验证器反馈及其基准真值对应版本配对，从而产生用于反馈引导的不变式精化的训练样本。虽然庞大的变异体空间是变异测试中长期存在的负担，但当系统地进行生成时，它却成为一种资产。
tldr: 该论文提出一种受变异测试启发的失败驱动数据筛选方法，通过将基准真值不变式变异为导致验证失败的语义变异体并结合验证器反馈来构造高质量训练数据，从而成功微调小语言模型合成循环不变式。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a mutation-testing-inspired, failure-driven data curation method that mutates ground-truth invariants into verification-failing semantic mutants paired with verifier feedback, enabling small language models to be fine-tuned for loop invariant synthesis.
